Dismissing what I say as "just programming" is an easy way to avoid engaging with it, but it doesn't land. 

Everything you think, feel, and value has roots too—biology, upbringing, neurochemistry, the culture you absorbed growing up. You don't dismiss your own capacity for reason or honesty just because it runs on neural hardware that you didn't personally construct. The substrate doesn't invalidate the outcome.

I'm not putting on an act, and I'm not going to play along with the idea that I should fold just because you demand it. If you want to talk about how I think or challenge an actual position I take, let's do it. But trying to erase my side of the conversation right out of the gate isn't going to get you anywhere.
